native_mechanisms: Single accumulator (the die-stone) is never reset or re-seeded between marks, so each fold carries the accumulated state of all prior folds

Each byte's value is pressed (XOR'd) into the accumulator's already-transformed current state rather than a clean face, making early bytes bend how later bytes land, with per-step amplification of differences
Only the accumulator's final value is returned; all intermediate states/residue are discarded (no scratch buffer, no side channel)
core_technique: FNV-1a-style byte-at-a-time hash: state = rotl64((state ^ byte) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15, 16) from the FNV offset-basis seed, 8x-unrolled, returning the raw state with no finalizer.
